name: aws_lambda
description: Manages a DuploCloud AI Helpdesk AWS Lambda function — a serverless compute resource that runs code in response to events within an environment and resource group.

attributes.name: workspace_id
attributes.description: ID of the workspace that owns this Lambda function.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the Lambda function.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Optional description of the Lambda function.

attributes.name: environment_id
attributes.description: ID of the environment in which the Lambda function runs.

attributes.name: resource_group_id
attributes.description: ID of the resource group in which the Lambda function runs.

attributes.name: provisioner_type
attributes.description: Provisioner type: Cli, IacNativeTf, IacDuploTf, or DirectApiCall.

attributes.name: provisioner_version
attributes.description: Optional provisioner version.

attributes.name: runtime
attributes.description: Lambda runtime identifier (e.g. python3.12, nodejs20.x, java21, provided.al2023). Not required for container image deployments.

attributes.name: handler
attributes.description: Function entrypoint in the format file.method (e.g. index.handler). Not required for container image deployments.

attributes.name: role_arn
attributes.description: ARN of the IAM role the function assumes when it runs.

attributes.name: memory_size
attributes.description: Amount of memory (in MB) allocated to the function. Defaults to 128.

attributes.name: timeout
attributes.description: Maximum number of seconds the function is allowed to run. Defaults to 3.

attributes.name: ephemeral_storage_size
attributes.description: Size (in MB) of the /tmp directory available to the function. Between 512 and 10240. Defaults to 512.

attributes.name: architectures
attributes.description: Instruction set architectures for the function. Valid values: x86_64, arm64. Defaults to [x86_64].

attributes.name: kms_key_arn
attributes.description: ARN of a KMS key used to encrypt the function's environment variables.

attributes.name: s3_bucket
attributes.description: S3 bucket containing the deployment package. Use with s3_key.

attributes.name: s3_key
attributes.description: S3 object key of the deployment package.

attributes.name: s3_object_version
attributes.description: S3 object version of the deployment package.

attributes.name: image_uri
attributes.description: URI of a container image in Amazon ECR. Use instead of s3_bucket/s3_key for container image deployments.

attributes.name: environment_variables
attributes.description: Environment variables available to the function at runtime.

attributes.name: subnet_ids
attributes.description: IDs of the VPC subnets to attach to the function. Required when the function needs to access VPC resources.

attributes.name: security_group_ids
attributes.description: IDs of the VPC security groups to attach to the function.

attributes.name: layers
attributes.description: List of Lambda layer ARNs to attach to the function (maximum 5).

attributes.name: tags
attributes.description: Tags to assign to the Lambda function.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current provisioning status of the Lambda function.

attributes.name: aws_lambda_id
attributes.description: ID of this Lambda function resource, for reference by dependent resources.

attributes.name: function_arn
attributes.description: ARN of the deployed Lambda function.

attributes.name: code_sha256
attributes.description: SHA-256 hash of the deployed function package.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Published version of the Lambda function.
